name: I Am The Prosecutor: No Evidence? No Problem!
source:
An abusive, narcissistic mother has been lashing out against her daughter for almost as long as she was born. Now as an Adult, the daughter decides to press charges against her abusive mother! Play as the prosecutor in charge of this case and give the daughter much needed closure so that she may be able to move on and live a normal life! It's not gonna be easy though, the defense is quite formidable herself...

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591470/]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
一位自恋又暴虐的母亲，几乎从女儿出生起就一直对她施加虐待。如今，已经成年的女儿决定起诉这位虐待自己的母亲！扮演负责此案的检察官，为女儿讨回公道，让她终于能够放下过去，继续过正常的生活！不过，这可不会轻松，因为辩护律师同样是个厉害的对手……

[摘自[URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591470/]Steam[/URL]]
